configurationAndRuleFindings.finding: Printed narrative says heavy-duty particle shielding but no ray shields as stock; SR 10 stat line preserved, not overwritten by generic no-shield inference.
Plasma beam cutter fires as pilot standard action into adjacent square; hit attaches to target hull without collision.
Each later round pilot uses standard action for grapple-based damage equal to the check result, ignoring target SR; accumulated damage beyond damage threshold opens breach for boarding.
Cutter use loses all shielding and prevents firing other weapons for that round; shielding and weapon systems resume at beginning of next pilot turn.
Detailed cutter attack has Dmg dash (grapple +38); no invented cutter damage dice.
No hyperdrive value printed; unknown, not proven absent.
